tools.name: context
tools.description: START HERE before editing a file. One compact pack: what the file is (page/module), the endpoints it serves, tables, the spec change that owns it, open tasks, and the tests to run. Cheaper than reading files or grepping.

depth.description: code: a short window at each anchor (opt-in)

tools.name: impact
tools.description: Full blast radius of a change: every module, endpoint, table, page, test and requirement it can reach, plus endpoints no test covers. Use when you need the complete list, not the summary.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Find endpoints, pages, modules, tables, requirements and tests by name. One line per hit. With text: true, scan source lines for a literal string (or a regex) instead.

text.description: search source lines instead of graph names

regex.description: treat query as a regular expression (text search only)

tools.name: remember
tools.description: Keep a short note next to files for the next session: a decision, a gotcha, why a shape is odd. Not what the map shows (owner, module, endpoints): context() has that. Returned as a note, not evidence.

tools.name: recall
tools.description: Notes previously remembered for these files, newest first. Pass no files for the newest notes in this repo.

tools.name: plan
tools.description: The next task of a spec change, with only what is needed to start it: its files, endpoints, tables, tests and the command to run them. Call this instead of reading tasks.md.

task.description: task id (T3); omit for the next unfinished one

tools.name: changes
tools.description: A spec change record: its tasks, open tasks, the files its tasks touch, and the blast radius of those files. With no argument, lists all change records.

tools.name: task_done
tools.description: Tick one task in a change record's tasks.md, the same edit as `weave spec task done`. plan(slug) returns the id; do not edit tasks.md yourself.

task.description: task id from plan, e.g. T3

tools.name: task_reopen
tools.description: Reopen one task in a change record's tasks.md, the same edit as `weave spec task reopen`. Use it when a ticked task turns out unfinished.

tools.name: change_new
tools.description: Create a change record under specs/changes: proposal.md, tasks.md and spec-delta.md, the same files as `weave spec new`. Returns the slug; plan(slug) then gives the first task.

name.description: slug, e.g. billing-retry; today's date is prefixed unless present

title.description: human title; defaults to the name

tools.name: change_delete
tools.description: Delete one change record and its three files. Irreversible: pass the exact change and confirm must be true.

confirm.description: must be true; the directory is removed

tools.name: changed
tools.description: What the graph gained or lost since a git ref (default HEAD) or a saved graph.json: endpoints, pages, tables, modules, requirements. A removed endpoint still called by the base is named with its caller count.

from.description: path to a saved graph.json, relative to the repo

all.description: show up to 60 per section instead of 12

tools.name: verify
tools.description: Run the gate on the current diff: broken calls, untested endpoints, the owning change, and the exact commands to run the tests. Call it before saying done.

files.description: repo-relative paths; default: the git diff

strict.description: an untested endpoint fails the gate

tools.name: status
tools.description: Graph health: node counts, endpoints no page calls, endpoints no test covers, pages without e2e.
